title: ConceptGraph
description: Ontologist output representing the concept graph extracted from a source document, including nodes, directed edges, detected cycles, and forward references.

manifest_version.description: Semantic version of the concept graph manifest format (e.g. "1.0.0").

source_file.description: Absolute or relative path to the source document from which this graph was extracted.

nodes.description: Concepts identified in the document, each representing a distinct term or idea.

cycles.description: Sets of node ids that form circular dependency cycles in the concept graph.

items.description: An ordered sequence of node ids forming a single cycle. The last node implicitly edges back to the first.

forward_references.description: Instances where a concept is used before its definition appears in the document.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings emitted during ontology extraction.

DocumentLocation.description: Pointer to a specific position within the source document.

section_id.description: Identifier of the section containing this location.

token_offset.description: Zero-based token offset within the section.

Node.description: A single concept node in the graph.

id.description: Unique identifier for this concept node within the graph.

label.description: Human-readable name or term for the concept.

definition_location.description: Location in the document where this concept is formally defined. Null if no explicit definition was found.

first_use_location.description: Location of the earliest use of this concept in the document. Null if the concept was not observed in use.

Edge.description: A directed relationship between two concept nodes.

from.description: Id of the source concept node.

to.description: Id of the target concept node.

confidence.description: Confidence score for this relationship, in the range [0, 1].

type.description: Semantic type of the relationship: 'prerequisite' means the source must be understood before the target, 'related' indicates loose association, 'cyclic' flags a member of a detected cycle.

ForwardReference.description: A detected instance where a concept is used before its definition appears in document order.

concept_id.description: Id of the concept node that is forward-referenced.

used_at_location.description: Location of the forward use of the concept.

defined_at_location.description: Location where the concept is eventually defined. Null if no definition was found anywhere in the document.

confidence.description: Confidence score that this is a genuine forward reference, in the range [0, 1].

Warning.description: A non-fatal warning emitted during ontology extraction.

module.description: Name of the ontologist module that emitted this warning.
